problem: Lucia has grown vegetables for 22 seasons. This spring she divides a 36-foot garden row into 4 equal planting sections. How long is each section?

problem: At the skating rink, 43 people were on the big rink and 18 on the small rink. How many people were skating?

problem: How many children are at the park if 43 are on the playground and 18 are on the soccer field?
follow_up_questions: Then 12 children go home. How many children are at the park now?

problem: A train ticket and a snack cost Leo 27 dollars. The snack alone cost 4 dollars. How much was the train ticket?
follow_up_questions: His friend buys only a ticket. How much do the two of them pay together?
Each of the two boys also buys a 3-dollar drink. How much have they spent now?
They had 60 dollars between them. How much money is left?

problem: What was the price of the museum ticket if a ticket plus a guidebook cost Iris 27 dollars and the guidebook was 4 dollars?
follow_up_questions: Her sister buys just a ticket. What do the sisters pay together?
Both sisters then buy a 3-dollar postcard. What is their total spending now?
They brought 60 dollars in all. How much do they have left?

problem: In the pet shop, 8 of the rabbits are babies and the other 37 are adults. How many rabbits are there?
follow_up_questions: The shop has 6 fewer guinea pigs than rabbits. How many guinea pigs are there?

problem: How many trees are in the orchard if 37 are apple trees and the other 8 are pear trees?
follow_up_questions: There are 6 fewer bushes than trees in the orchard. How many bushes are there?

problem: Over the summer, the campers used 42 logs from the woodpile, leaving 9. How many logs were in the woodpile at first?
follow_up_questions: In autumn, 30 new logs are added to what is left. How many logs are there now?
If the camp burns 3 logs a week, how many weeks will the logs last?

problem: How many jars of jam did Grandma have at first if her family ate 42 jars over the winter and 9 are left?
follow_up_questions: In summer she makes 30 new jars and adds them to the shelf. How many jars are there now?
If the family eats 3 jars a week, for how many weeks will the jam last?

problem: A bag has 62 marbles. Of these, 18 are blue and the rest are green. The bag is made of cloth. How many green marbles are there?
How many of the 62 cookies on the tray are oatmeal cookies if 18 are chocolate and the rest are oatmeal? The kitchen smells sweet.
Mr Novak's bookshop has 36 books in the window and 47 books on a table inside. How many books is that in total?
follow_up_questions: He sells 23 of them. How many books are left in the shop?

problem: What is the total number of fish if a pet store has 36 fish in one tank and 47 in another?
follow_up_questions: A customer buys 23 fish. How many fish are left?

problem: The art room had 33 paintbrushes at the start of the year, but 15 got ruined over the winter. How many good paintbrushes are left?
follow_up_questions: The teacher buys 12 new ones. How many good paintbrushes are there now?
They are shared equally among 5 tables. How many does each table get?

problem: How many bikes in the rental shop still work if it had 33 bikes and 15 broke this summer?
follow_up_questions: The owner buys 12 new bikes. How many working bikes are there now?
She splits them equally among 5 parking racks. How many bikes go on each rack?

problem: The museum had 48 school visitors this morning. A guide took 29 of them to the dinosaur hall, and the rest went to the space room. How many visitors went to the space room?
follow_up_questions: Each visitor in the space room got 2 star stickers. How many stickers were given out?

problem: Find the number of campers swimming if 48 campers are at the lake and 29 of them are canoeing while the rest swim.
follow_up_questions: Each swimmer uses 2 towels. How many towels are needed?

problem: The school library has 37 picture books and 29 chapter books on the new shelf. How many books are on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: It turns out 8 of them are too damaged to lend. How many books can be lent out?
The library wants 93 books it can lend. How many more must it buy?

problem: How many costumes are in the theater closet if it holds 37 pirate costumes and 29 fairy costumes?
follow_up_questions: Moths have ruined 8 of the costumes. How many good costumes are left?
The play needs 93 good costumes. How many more costumes must be made?

problem: After picking 26 apples, Rina found 19 more on a low branch and picked those too. A bird was singing in the tree. How many apples has she picked?
How many shells has Bo collected? He picked up 26 shells near the pier and then 19 more by the rocks. The sand was warm.
In the barn, 34 chickens are in the big pen and 25 are in the small pen. How many chickens are in the barn?
follow_up_questions: At feeding time, each chicken gets 2 handfuls of corn. How many handfuls does the farmer need?

problem: What is the total number of children at the camp if 34 sleep in the north cabin and 25 sleep in the south cabin?
follow_up_questions: Each child gets 2 pancakes for breakfast. How many pancakes must the cook make?

problem: On Saturday the red apple tree gave 18 apples and the green apple tree gave 41. How many more apples did the green tree give?
follow_up_questions: How many apples did the two trees give together?
Ten of the apples were bruised. How many good apples were there?

problem: How many more points did Team Blue score than Team Gold if Team Gold scored 18 and Team Blue scored 41?
follow_up_questions: What was the total of the two teams' points?
The judges took away 10 points for breaking rules. How many points were left?

problem: Hugo's bookshelf has 52 storybooks but only 25 science books. What is the difference?
follow_up_questions: He gives away 12 storybooks. Now how many more storybooks than science books does he have?
His aunt gives him 8 science books. How many science books does he have now?
How many books are on the shelf altogether now?

problem: How many more red beads than gold beads does Amaya have in her box of 52 red beads and 25 gold beads?
follow_up_questions: She uses 12 red beads on a bracelet. How many more red than gold beads does she have now?
Her friend gives her 8 gold beads. How many gold beads does she have now?
What is the total number of beads in her box now?

problem: The gym closet held 32 jump ropes. One class borrowed 6 in the morning, and another borrowed 15 in the afternoon. How many jump ropes are still in the closet?
follow_up_questions: Later the afternoon class returns its jump ropes. How many are in the closet now?

problem: How many bikes are still at the rental stand if it had 32 bikes, a family rented 6 in the morning and a school group rented 15 at noon?
follow_up_questions: When the school group brings back its bikes, how many bikes are at the stand?

problem: Of the 45 balloons at the party, just 17 are red. All the other balloons are yellow. How many yellow balloons are there?
follow_up_questions: Children pop 9 yellow balloons. How many yellow balloons are left?
How many balloons of the two colors are still at the party?

problem: How many puppies at the shelter are spotted if there are 45 puppies and 17 of them are plain brown?
follow_up_questions: Families adopt 9 spotted puppies. How many spotted ones are left?
How many puppies, spotted and brown, are still at the shelter?

problem: A flower stall had 74 roses. Shoppers bought 48 of them. How many roses does the stall still have?
How many tickets are still unsold if a theater had 74 tickets and has sold 48?
